description: Answerable retrieval questions grounded in the four fictional approved clinic policy examples.

questions.question: How can I request an appointment?

evidence.appointment-scheduling.md: may be requested by contacting the fictional scheduling desk or by using the fictional online booking page

questions.question: When is an appointment time I requested confirmed?

evidence.appointment-scheduling.md: Requested times are not confirmed until the fictional clinic sends a confirmation.

questions.question: Which details should I verify in the appointment confirmation?

evidence.appointment-scheduling.md: Please check the confirmation for the appointment date, time, and location.

questions.question: What should I do if the appointment confirmation is incorrect?

evidence.appointment-scheduling.md: If the confirmation appears incorrect, contact the fictional scheduling desk before the appointment.

questions.question: Can I request an appointment through the online booking page?

evidence.appointment-scheduling.md: may be requested by contacting the fictional scheduling desk or by using the fictional online booking page

questions.question: Who should I contact to cancel or change an appointment?

evidence.cancellations.md: may contact the fictional scheduling desk

questions.question: If I used the online booking page, where might I request an appointment change?

evidence.cancellations.md: the fictional page may also provide a way to request a change

questions.question: How will I know whether my cancellation or new time was recorded?

evidence.cancellations.md: will confirm whether the cancellation or new time has been recorded

questions.question: When should I consider a requested appointment change complete?

evidence.cancellations.md: should not be considered complete until confirmation is received

questions.question: What should I wait for before treating a requested cancellation as complete?

evidence.cancellations.md: should not be considered complete until confirmation is received

questions.question: What should I do if I expect to arrive late?

evidence.late-arrivals.md: may contact the fictional scheduling desk as soon as practical

questions.question: How soon should I contact the scheduling desk when I am running behind?
Who can explain whether a late appointment can still be accommodated?

evidence.late-arrivals.md: Staff can explain whether the appointment can still be accommodated

questions.question: What might staff suggest if a late appointment cannot be accommodated?
What may affect whether a late arrival can be accommodated?

evidence.late-arrivals.md: Availability may depend on the fictional schedule.

questions.question: How may I receive an appointment reminder?

evidence.reminders.md: may be sent using the contact method selected for a fictional booking

questions.question: What determines the contact method used for an appointment reminder?

evidence.reminders.md: the contact method selected for a fictional booking

questions.question: Does an appointment reminder replace checking the appointment confirmation?

evidence.reminders.md: A reminder is a courtesy and does not replace checking the appointment confirmation.

questions.question: What should I do if I do not receive an appointment reminder?

evidence.reminders.md: may check the fictional online booking page or contact the fictional scheduling desk to confirm the appointment details

questions.question: Where can I confirm my appointment details if a reminder does not arrive?

evidence.reminders.md: check the fictional online booking page or contact the fictional scheduling desk to confirm the appointment details
